en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a cobblestoned street lined with tall trees on the left and the historic Gruuthuse complex on the right. The long brick building features stepped gables, tall chimneys, and a prominent round tower with a conical roof. A lone figure walks down the quiet street. Printed caption text at the top identifies the view as the Gruuthuse in Bruges.
